slot.brief: Give four similar-looking words; ask which one appears first (or arrange in dictionary order) — careful with third/fourth letter tie-breakers.

stem: Which of the following words appears first in an English dictionary?

verdicts.working: All options begin with “Sta.” Comparing the next letter: Starch has “c,” which comes before “e,” “k,” and “t.”
